regulatory_framework.regulation_name: MERC Forecasting, Scheduling and Deviation Settlement (F&S) Regulations
rules: Zero Penalty Corridor: When Schedule is within ±10% of Available Capacity (±10.08 MW of Actuals), deviation penalty is exactly ZERO.
Over-forecasting (Excess): When Schedule > Actual + 10.08 MW, generator pays DSM penalty on excess deviation (Schedule - Actual - 10.08 MW).
Under-forecasting (Shortfall): When Schedule < Actual - 10.08 MW, generator ALSO pays DSM penalty on shortfall deviation (Actual - Schedule - 10.08 MW).
Symmetric Enforcement: BOTH over-predicting and under-predicting are penalized under Maharashtra regulations.
Penalty Formula: Penalty (INR) = Deviation_Beyond_10.08MW * 1000 kW/MW * 0.25 hours * Rs 3.275/kWh * Slab_Multiplier
Slab 1 (10% to 15% / 10.08 to 15.12 MW error): Multiplier = 10% of PPA rate = Rs 0.3275/kWh
Slab 2 (15% to 25% / 15.12 to 25.20 MW error): Multiplier = 20% of PPA rate = Rs 0.6550/kWh
Slab 3 (> 25% / > 25.20 MW error): Multiplier = 30% of PPA rate = Rs 0.9825/kWh

practical_examples.example_safe: Actual = 60.00 MW. Safe Band = [49.92 MW, 70.08 MW]. Schedule = 68.00 MW -> Error = +8.00 MW (<= 10.08 MW) -> Penalty = Rs 0.00.
practical_examples.example_over_forecast: Actual = 60.00 MW. Schedule = 75.00 MW -> Error = +15.00 MW -> Deviation beyond 10% = 15.00 - 10.08 = 4.92 MW -> Penalty = 4,920 kW * 0.25 h * Rs 3.275 * 0.10 = Rs 402.83.
practical_examples.example_under_forecast: Actual = 60.00 MW. Schedule = 40.00 MW -> Error = -20.00 MW -> Deviation beyond 10% = 20.00 - 10.08 = 9.92 MW -> Penalty = 5.04 MW in Slab 1 (Rs 412.65) + 4.88 MW in Slab 2 (Rs 799.10) = Rs 1,211.75.

behavioral_dossier.nocturnal_low_level_jet: 20:00 to 05:30 IST: Strong sustained winds produce 50.0 to 95.0 MW. Night is peak production. Never zero out night blocks.
behavioral_dossier.morning_decoupling: 05:30 to 08:30 IST: Solar heating breaks inversion; generation steep decay from ~70 MW to ~15 MW.
behavioral_dossier.daytime_thermal_lull: 08:30 to 18:15 IST: Convective boundary layer mixing causes daytime lull with generation 0.5 to 7.0 MW.
behavioral_dossier.evening_transition_ramp: 18:15 to 19:45 IST: Rapid up-ramp from ~4 MW to >65 MW in 30-45 minutes. Critical penalty risk window.

recent_summary.correction_hint: Respect Maharashtra MERC strict 10% (10.08 MW) two-sided tolerance band. Target within [Actual - 10.08 MW, Actual + 10.08 MW].

llm_context_summary: JEWLI: 100.8 MW Wind plant (28x Siemens Gamesa SG 3.6-145, 133.5m hub height) in Dharashiv, Maharashtra.
MAHARASHTRA MERC 10% TWO-SIDED PENALTY BAND MANDATE: The tolerance band is strictly ±10% (±10.08 MW).
ZERO-PENALTY SAFE CORRIDOR: Deviations within [Actual - 10.08 MW, Actual + 10.08 MW] incur Rs. 0 penalty.
BOTH OVER-FORECASTING (>+10.08 MW) AND UNDER-FORECASTING (<-10.08 MW) ARE PENALIZED at PPA tariff Rs. 3.275/kWh.
DO NOT excessively haircut schedule into under-forecasting penalty; DO NOT inflate into over-forecasting penalty.
24-HOUR CONTINUOUS GENERATION: Wind produces continuously. Night generation (20:00 - 05:30) is PEAK (50.0 to 95.0 MW) due to Deccan Low-Level Jet.
DAYTIME THERMAL LULL: 08:30 to 18:15 generation drops to 0.5 to 7.0 MW due to boundary layer solar mixing.
EVENING RAMP DETECTION: 18:15 to 19:30 exhibits steep ramp from ~4 MW to >65 MW. Align ramp closely to avoid crossing the ±10.08 MW corridor.

entries.summary: 2026-09-17: Night LLJ sustained 58-86 MW; daytime thermal lull 2-6 MW; evening ramp initiated at 18:30 jumping to 72 MW by 19:30. Forecast adhered inside ±10.08 MW MERC band for 91% of blocks.
lessons: Evening ramp started 15 min earlier than GFS forecast; anchor to SCADA 18:00 mast velocity.
Midday lull floor reached 1.2 MW; keep daytime schedule strictly below 6 MW during calm sunny periods.

actual_pattern.summary: Peak 86.4 MW at 02:15; minimum 0.8 MW at 14:30; evening ramp +58 MW between 18:30 and 19:45.

entries.summary: 2026-09-16: Night generation averaged 64.2 MW; daytime lull averaged 4.1 MW; evening ramp surged to 68.5 MW at 19:15. All night blocks remained within safe MERC ±10.08 MW corridor.
lessons: Maintained high night generation without haircutting, avoiding shortfall penalty.

actual_pattern.summary: Continuous night generation peaking at 89.2 MW; smooth morning breakdown between 06:00 and 08:00.
